cases.sentence: И я увидел в ___ трона, в окружении четырех живых существ и старцев, Ягненка, выглядевшего так, будто Его принесли в жертву.
cases.explain: «самом центре» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: I saw in the middle of the throne and of the four living creatures, and in the middle of the elders, a Lamb standing, as though it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God, sent out into all the earth.

cases.sentence: И я увидел в самом центре трона, в окружении четырех ___ и старцев, Ягненка, выглядевшего так, будто Его принесли в жертву.
cases.explain: «живых существ» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: I saw in the middle of the throne and of the four living creatures, and in the middle of the elders, a Lamb standing, as though it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God, sent out into all the earth.

cases.sentence: Он подошел и взял свиток из ___ Сидящего на троне.
cases.explain: «правой руки» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Then he came, and he took it out of the right hand of him who sat on the throne.

cases.sentence: У каждого из них в руках было по арфе и по ___, полному благовоний — это молитвы святых.
cases.explain: «золотому сосуду» — after the preposition «по», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: Now when he had taken the book, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb, each one having a harp, and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.
